spiritual_reading.full_translation:
A vast discrimination came into effect, and a new state opened: the Divine brought into determinate order what would serve revelation, and the First Stable Foundation was made manifest within the inmost Divine.

When the Divine issued the full inward impulsion, wisdom was brought forth for the work and remained for an immeasurable state within that first inmost foundation.

Even if someone could set exact bounds and calculations for every least particular in the lowest degree, and for every gathered perception in elevated states, and for every general knowledge in externals, and for the whole expanse of ultimate frameworks; even if all these were poured out and compared with the completeness of ultimates and the containing forms that encompass the whole created order—still all such fineness of calculation would not reach the duration of that prior abiding.

The least particulars in the lowest degree, and even the least particulars of the whole created order, could in some way be numbered and surveyed; but the duration of the state in which the Great Divine Power remained within the first inmost foundation cannot be computed.

Love first brought wisdom into determinate form and held wisdom within its deepest interiors, in peace and unmanifest potency. When reception required it, wisdom was summoned and proceeded from the Divine of Greatness. Wisdom immediately perceived all the organized goods and truths within her whole domain.

Again, from the state when wisdom was summoned toward lower operation, she imparted living force to what would act as her instrument, and she held within herself the totality of ordered goods and truths and gathered them into one; the same manner of ordering held also in the one who first engages the conflict.

Thus the first combatant remained long in consecration within wisdom, fixed within her deepest interiors in restrained quiet; and the whole stretch of states that has been recounted—from the descent into contest until the later completion when the final formed state comes into being—belongs to his manifestation within that interval.

Again, from the state when he was summoned and proceeded forth, until the state when he himself summoned a sufficient fullness of luminous operative powers that proceed from him, those powers too remained long within their source. This is the same span marked from the descent of the first combatant until the ascent into the last formed completion. During that whole duration the operative powers remained in consecration within him; yet when use required them, they were summoned and proceeded forth.

Attend also to this so that the matter may be grasped. When wisdom was summoned from the Divine of Greatness and proceeded outward by free consent from the most interior elevation toward the lowest degree, it would appear as states upon states without number until the ultimate degree were reached, for there is no fixed bound nor measurable rule to the elevations of the Divine. Yet it was not by gradual traversal that she arrived, but by immediate Divine determination: as the Divine had summoned her within the Great Divine Power, so the Divine instantly established her in the realm of greatness through a specific mediation drawn from the complete hidden order of organized truths protected within interior light, stabilized after a prior ordering of an ultimate region.

The operation of wisdom is like this: when the Divine summons her, the Divine fixes her where it pleases, to set her there as doctrine and guidance for receptive minds; and her perception ranges everywhere in an instant, with swift discernment such as belongs to spiritual thought.

This likewise is the manner whenever wisdom is put forth toward an appointed function: the Divine perfects her within the Great Divine Power and establishes her in the state it pleases, according to Divine good pleasure.

In the same way, a sufficient fullness of luminous operative powers was summoned from the first combatant. They were arranged before him as he willed so that ordered force might descend into the lower degree and govern there in mutual subordination. He ordered and distributed their operations to those in lower states; then he removed from himself the external forms of their operation and constrained his own activity into restrained quiet at the ultimate limit of the lowest degree, fixing each power within its proper measure.

Again, the first combatant remained through a long span of states until he imparted power to these operative forces and fully took them into his own action. After he invested himself with their operations, he stood firm in an elevated middle state between ultimates. Again, he remained in a duration of states as abundant as the constant gentle inflow of enlightening truth, and the soft pacifying influx from higher love, and the obscure descending persuasions that drift into the created order. Thus he remained, standing between ultimates, until the appointed moment when he cast himself into the spiritual contest.

Whenever the Divine of Greatness summoned the Great Divine Power and the first combatant and the glorious operative powers provided to make revelation possible, at that same state the Divine also formed the great ordering intelligence in the realm of light, and formed living Divine operation with mighty active powers proceeding from it. At that same state also the Divine formed the mediating message, together with illuminating Divine truth, pure receptive innocence, and the sustaining witness of glory, and the powers proceeding from them. The Divine formed all these in a single act. They proceeded from one another in a successive ordering; the duration lay not in the Divine act itself but in the reception and in the work in lower degrees.

From the state when active denial of good rose up against the very essence of light and truth, three ordered outgoings were, by the Divine will, set in motion against the adversarial falsity and evil: to establish the created order, to effect separation, and to bring the Divine into tranquil rule within its kingdom. This continues until the state when the Divine presence is made manifest over all the powers of glory and over all the rich fulfillments of those outgoings that went forth against the adversary.

From the state when these three ordered outgoings were formed until the state when the Divine presence is made manifest and they enter into the Divine hidden interiors and are called and each is established in its own function and place, there is no measurable bound nor fixed rule to that whole duration.

Again, concerning the contrary process, an account is given of the origin of the opposing substance, the intention of spiritual death: this is the way it rose into its own interiors, and it came into act within a sufficient series of fundamental falsities.

Again, it remained through a great span of states until it made itself manifest within those falsities, before it organized itself into systems of perverted perception. It stood fixed for a long duration in its own interior confirmations, then remained long within those perverted perceptions before it produced works from them.

Again, it remained a long duration within those works. Not small is the span it spent existing in such works before, after long continuance, it produced the hells of its organized domains in varied forms; the multiplication is spoken of as beyond exact measure, and the perversion reached a kind of completion as those works became living evils within those hells. They turned upon their own lowest loves and were sustained; and not little is the period they remained within their domains until they were nourished among their like, to oppose the shining realm and the great ruling good that dwells there.

It is also known that when the adversary seized upon what is living from the essence of light and truth, it took to itself opposing substance and drew it into conflict against the perfect form of humanity. From the state when that conflict began, the subsequent states unfold.

The first state in this sequence is fragmentary and does not fully yield; it appears to describe an initial entanglement in deceptive constraint.

The second state is that an ordered structure for the created order was built and fixed, and the middle region of operation continues from its establishment until the time when it will be brought to an end.

The third state is the continuing duration of all existing things within that created order, from the time they were established until the time when their end is completed and their present mode of being ceases.

The fourth state is dissolution: the created order is brought to an end, and all things in that mode are destroyed; devastation reaches them through an all-consuming ardor of self-love that burns through remaining forms for a fixed stated period.

The fifth state is the formation of the final perfected completion from the remnant of all things: what is living and true is separated into its own place, ascends, and reigns in its kingdom; but falsity and evil are gathered into confinement and bound to their own opposition in an unending restraint.

From the first beginning of conflict until the final restraint, these five states are the whole course by which what is living and true is led through time toward full liberation.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Strong coherence from ¶1–¶16: a consistent line about immeasurable divine durations, orderly outgoings, and placement of wisdom and operative powers across degrees. A clear opposing mirror-process appears in ¶20–¶22 (falsity → perverted perception → works → organized hells). The narrative stumbles only at ¶24 due to severe textual damage; the five-stage schema from ¶25–¶29 restores coherence and provides a firm concluding summary.

findings.diagnosis: Fragmentary opening, but the remaining clauses still introduce the chapter’s governing theme (primordial ‘sculpting/revealing’ within the Father). No clear voice-conflict; difficulty is physical damage, not insertion.
findings.evidence: Text: "[There occurred] a great ju[dge] ... they sculpt[ed] he was revealed in the Father, the first established thing." The spiritual reading notes: "fragmentary wording ... forces a compressed rendering." This is a classic damaged incipit: broken syntax, but thematically consistent with what follows (primordial establishment/revelation, then duration). Removing it would not improve continuity because it is the thematic headline.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential substrate on emanation-by-function and immeasurable duration: calling-forth, abiding in ‘storehouses’ (interior potential), proceeding when ‘needed,’ and parallelism between Mother of Life / First Man / five sons. The spiritual reading can derive sense from functions (summons → emergence; storehouse → latency; anointing → consecration).
findings.evidence: Text anchors: "two summonses" (¶2); "He established her in his inner storehouses in quiet and silence" (¶5); "When [they had] need of her she was called and came forth" (¶5); "This [is also the case] with the First Man" (¶6); "five shining [gods] who are his sons" (¶8). The reading’s narrative is smooth here and explicitly reports coherence (overall: "Strong coherence from ¶1–¶16"). No named-jurisdiction lists appear; the names participate as functional roles in the process of calling/forthgoing/abiding.

findings.diagnosis: Clean rhetorical unit contrasting what is countable in creation with what is uncountable in divine duration; correspondential argument by function (measuring grains/sand vs inability to measure primordial abiding). Damage exists in details, but does not introduce a foreign didactic mode.
findings.evidence: Text: "set a measure and rule ... the earth ... sea ... firmaments" (¶3) and "possible to count the {particles} ... but the duration ... one will not be able to make a count of it!" (¶4). The reading explicitly treats this as a coherent contrast and says ¶4 is "Clean despite damaged words." That is ‘genuine difficulty’ only at the micro-level; the macro-structure is intact.

findings.diagnosis: Insertion into a functional narrative: a sudden administrative-cosmographic aside (“three…twelve hidden ones…light veil…south”) interrupts the otherwise correspondential teaching on immeasurable heights and immediate divine establishment. The story flows if that bureaucratic-location formula is removed.
findings.evidence: Text moves smoothly until the bureaucratic locator: "For there is no measure nor rule to the heights of the Father. Rather, ... he set her upon [the] land of greatness through one of these three that are counted to the twelve hidden ones within the light veil, the ones [esta]blished after the [ordered] region of the south." The spiritual reading flags this as "highly specific" and has to genericize it into "a specific mediation drawn from the complete hidden order..."—a telltale stumble: the reading cannot derive the spiritual sense from function, only by blurring the administrative detail. The ‘three counted to the twelve’ plus directional stationing (“south”) is governance/cartography language, not functional correspondence.
findings.scope: "...through one of these three that are counted to the twelve hidden ones within the light veil, the ones [esta]blished after the [ordered] region of the south."

findings.diagnosis: Return to coherent correspondential teaching about placement-by-will and instantaneous perception; then functional ordering of powers (distribution, measures, silence at the border) and a poised interval ‘between the borders.’ Damage is present in ¶12 but it is the same functional voice, not a foreign administrative overlay.
findings.evidence: Text: "to establish her there as the instruction of the people" (¶10); "blink of an eye... bird swift" (¶10) supports the reading’s ‘instantaneous discernment’ without forcing. ¶12 has broken clauses but the functional core remains: "ordered and distributed"; "fixed ... in their measures"; "silence upon the border of the earth." The reading notes ¶12 is "heavily corrupted" yet still narratively usable; that is consistent with damaged substrate rather than insertion.

findings.diagnosis: Administrative insertion into an otherwise correspondential duration-narrative: a systematizing list of named salvific officials with their dependents (“gods who came from them”), introduced with seam language (“Also, at that time”). This reads like Mani’s governance taxonomy (who/what ranks proceed from whom), not teaching by function; it forces the spiritual reading to translate proper names into abstractions.
findings.evidence: Text: "Also, at that time, he sculpted the [Amb]assador, with Jesus the Splendour and the Virgin of Light and the Pillar of Glory, and the gods who came from them. [All these ... sculpted at] a single time. They came forth of one another, one after one". The spiritual reading admits the mismatch: "Named figures ... are translated by function; exact distinctions ... may be more nuanced." That is precisely the stumble: the passage’s didactic force is administrative pedigree (emanation roster + subordinates), not functional correspondence. The chapter’s surrounding logic is about immeasurable durations of abiding/calling (¶1–¶13) and then a threefold mission arc (¶15–¶16). ¶14’s roster is not required for that story; removing it yields a cleaner transition from the ‘calling’ theme to the conflict/mission theme.
findings.scope: "Whenever the Father of Greatn[e]ss called the Great Spirit and the First Man and the gods of the glorious one, who are provided to enable them to reveal him; at that very time [he] sculpted the Great Builder in the [land of] light, [and] the Living Spirit with the mighty and active gods who came [from] him. Also, at that time, he sculpted the [Amb]assador, with Jesus the Splendour and the Virgin of Light and the Pillar of Glory, and the gods who came from them. [All these the Father of Greatness sculpted at] a single time. They came forth of one another, one after one; the time when [the appearing] and the work."

findings.diagnosis: Despite heavy damage in ¶15, the unit reads as a coherent correspondential arc: uprising of darkness, three emanations sent ‘against the enemy,’ and the long period until unveiling/reintegration. This is functional narrative about process and telos, not jurisdictional listing.
findings.evidence: Text: "darkness raised itself up... these three emanations... against the enemy" (¶15) and "From... he sculpted these three... till... unveil his face... go in to his hidden storehouses... establishes each one..." (¶16). The spiritual reading reports ¶15 is "badly broken" and infers the threefold purpose from surviving verbs ("establish, separate, rejoice/rule"). That is a damage problem, not a voice intrusion: the passage still teaches by what the emanations DO.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential ‘mirror-process’ of Matter: staged becoming and incubation (storehouses → elements/trees/fruits → worlds/hells), described in developmental functions. The ‘five elements / five worlds’ numeration does not by itself signal Mani’s seam-expansion here because it is integrated into a process description rather than a roster of authorities.
findings.evidence: Text: "It has [come to be] in its five elements" (¶20); then successive incubation locales: "before it came to the trees" (¶21), "spent a long time in the fruits" (¶22), then "the d[emon]s of its five worlds" (¶22). The spiritual reading explicitly experiences narrative coherence here ("A clear opposing mirror-process appears in ¶20–¶22").

findings.diagnosis: A fivefold schema closes the chapter; mostly coherent as a summarizing didactic unit. The only real break is ¶24, where the text is too damaged to recover the first item. The fivefold structure is not, by itself, evidence of Mani’s seam-expansion because it is not appended as a foreign reclassification to a prior non-five structure; rather, it is the chapter’s own concluding timeline from war to chain. Treat ¶24 as genuine damage.
findings.evidence: Text introduces a sequence: "[The first is this:]" (¶24) ... "[The second is this:]" (¶25) ... through "[The fift]h" (¶28), and summary (¶29). The spiritual reading’s only stumble is exactly at ¶24: "fragmentary and does not fully yield" due to "ensnared a snare." That is a damage diagnosis, not a narrative-voice conflict. Elsewhere, the items are process-functional (building cosmos, duration, dissolution, final separation/binding) rather than a list of administrators.

textual_criticism.summary: 9 findings. Two high-confidence administrative insertions into a correspondential duration-narrative: the cosmographic ‘three/twelve hidden ones/south’ locator in ¶9 and the emanation-roster with named officials (including Jesus the Splendour) in ¶14; both recommended for excision because the spiritual reading had to abstract or smooth over their governance/pedigree character and the chapter’s story flows without them. All other difficulties are best explained as genuine textual damage (notably ¶1, ¶12, ¶15, and especially ¶24) within an otherwise coherent correspondential substrate.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: [There occurred] a great ju[dge] now also a ti[me] that they sculpt[ed] he was revealed in the Father, the first established thing.
W[he]n [he called forth] the two summonses that he called [these] the Mother of Life [and he established] a long duration in the first Father [herself]

For someone, if he might set a measure and rule [of the air and the winds] the earth {particles} and the {pebbles} of the mountains and [out upon one another,] of the sea and the body of the firmaments. Should they be poured [out also upon] the body of the four mountains and the three vessels that surround the universe; if they shall all be poured out [out as well upon] these fine {granules}.

Happen you know that the grains of the earth {particles} are measurable, [and those of] the [entire] universe.
